INSERT INTO leads (
    id,
    nome,
    numero1,
    numero2,
    qualificacao,
    origem,
    proprietario_contato,
    data_atribuicao
)
VALUES (
    {{ $json.hs_object_id }}::bigint,
    NULLIF('{{ ($json.nome ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ ($json.phone ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ ($json.mobilephone ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ ($json.qualificacao ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ ($json.origem ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ $json.proprietario_contato ?? "" }}', '')::bigint,
  NULLIF('{{ $json.hubspot_owner_assigneddate ?? "" }}', '')::timestamp
)
ON CONFLICT (id)
DO UPDATE SET
    nome = EXCLUDED.nome,
    numero1 = EXCLUDED.numero1,
    numero2 = EXCLUDED.numero2,
    qualificacao = EXCLUDED.qualificacao,
    origem = EXCLUDED.origem,
    proprietario_contato = EXCLUDED.proprietario_contato,
    data_atribuicao = EXCLUDED.data_atribuicao;

INSERT INTO sync_control (
    workflow_name,
    last_success_at,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    'hubspot_leads',
    '{{ $json.nowIso }}'::timestamp,
    NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (workflow_name)
DO UPDATE SET
    last_success_at = EXCLUDED.last_success_at,
    updated_at = NOW();
